packages.citation: the base layer: the official image builds FROM alpine:3.24, whose apk world installs busybox
the base layer: musl is alpine's libc, installed by the alpine base image before the Node layers
the application layer: the official image's Dockerfile copies the Node 22 binaries into the later layers

component-layer.notes: The label states what the layer attribution would say; dep-scan's image BOM records no layer today, which is what the score reports.
